in_sanskrit.name: Motibur
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Pearl of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Motibur एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Motibur is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘moti’ which means pearl and ‘bur’ which means earth. It is a name that signifies the one who is a precious gem in this world, just like a pearl is a precious gem in water. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Lakshmi is often depicted sitting on a lotus flower that grows out of the water, symbolizing the connection between the divine and the earth. Motibur is a name that celebrates this connection and the preciousness of life.
